name: Lily Trail: A Tale of Spirits that Bloom in the West
source:
Guided by a mysterious and recurring dream, a lone Sister leaves her abbey on the small island of Hybraesail and travels across the sea to the West. This is finally her chance to make her dream come true of founding her own school.

She joins a wagon driven by the mysterious Ven Barrister who plans to take a secret route. Joining her are Beatrix—a well-to-do young woman, Palmira—a skilled hunter and guide, Euodia—a woman hoping to improve herself, and a young girl named Itzel. However, not everything is that simple. Ven's past is filled with trouble, the other travelers have their own issues, and Itzel keeps talking about...a wish granting dragon?

[From [url=https://rosin.itch.io/lily-trail]itch.io[/url]]
